nodes.long_description:
Your coach calls the combination. You move, punch, slip. This is pad work — real pad work. Not a rhythm game. Not a cardio app. The training fighters actually do, in your living room.

Boxing is a craft. Footwork, guard discipline, hip rotation on the cross — not learned by pressing buttons. Drilled into instinct.

Boxing Drills puts you in front of virtual pads and holds you to real standards. Punch too soft? It doesn't count. Drop your guard? That's a point off. Stand flat-footed? The trainer steps out of range — move.

**Train like it means something**
- 30+ drills across punch combos, defense, and footwork
- Pad trainer shifts laterally and forward/back — reposition or lose the angle
- Minimum punch velocity threshold — weak shots don't register, so you learn to commit
- Body engagement scoring — measures hip rotation, not just arm speed
- Real-time hit feedback: punch speed (m/s), body effort, and power score on every impact
- Southpaw mode — train in your natural stance

**Track what matters**

Power · Speed · Agility · Form — scored every session and compared against your personal bests. Career mode builds your fighter profile and tests you across 8 opponents. Workout mode chains drills back-to-back for sessions up to 60 minutes.

**Built for Quest. No subscriptions. Open source.**

One purchase. Everything included. Join the Discord at https://discord.gg/8FyagxceKs and help shape what comes next.

*Clear some space. Put the headset on. Throw a real punch.*
nodes.short_description:
Real pad work. In your living room.

Throw combinations, slip punches, move your feet — the virtual trainer shifts position and your punches only count if they land hard. This isn't a rhythm game. It's how fighters actually train.

30+ drills. Workout mode chains them back-to-back for up to 60 minutes of continuous training. Real-time power, speed, agility, and form scoring. Career mode. No subscription.

Put the headset on. Throw a real punch.

nodes.long_description:
# Train Like a Real Boxer

Boxing Drills VR brings authentic pad training to your Quest. No gym required.

**Realistic Drills**

Follow a virtual trainer through classic boxing combinations:
- **1-2 (Jab-Cross)** - The fundamental combo
- **1-2-Duck** - Add defensive movement
- **1-2-3** - Jab, Cross, Hook
- **1-2-3-2** - Extended combinations
- **Uppercut combos** - Work those body shots
- **Growing Library** - A vast selection of drills with new content added regularly!

**Built for Performance**

We know every millisecond counts when you're in the pocket.
- Low-Latency Precision: Built from the ground up for high-performance tracking.
- Native Feel: Optimized to ensure smooth, responsive feedback that feels like hitting real pads.

**Get Scored**

Every session tracks your performance:
- **Power** - Hit those pads hard
- **Speed** - Quick reactions matter
- **Agility** - Duck and weave like a pro
- **Form** - Return to guard after every punch

**Train Your Way**
- Multiple drill durations (30s to 3 min)
- Choose the speed that suits you (slow, medium, fast, progressive, variable)
- Passthrough mode - train safely in your own space

**Perfect For**
- Beginners learning boxing basics
- Fitness enthusiasts wanting a fun workout
- Experienced boxers staying sharp

No experience needed. Just clear some space, put on your Quest, and start throwing punches.

**Shape the Future (Open Source)**

We believe the best training tools are built by the community. We are moving toward an open-source model so the community can help us shape the roadmap of the product.
nodes.short_description: Train like a boxer in VR. Follow realistic pad drills with jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts. Practice defense with duck-and-weave combos. Track your power, speed, and form after every session.

nodes.change_log:
### v0.12.0

**Background Music**
- Music now plays continuously across all states — no longer cuts out when a drill starts
- Five original tracks generated with Google Gemini Lyria 3, each with a distinct training vibe:
  - Track 1: 128 BPM high-energy electronic / underground combat sports
  - Track 2: 95 BPM old-school hip-hop boom-bap (default)
  - Track 3: 110 BPM dark cinematic orchestral-electronic hybrid
  - Track 4: 140 BPM aggressive trap with 808 bass slides
  - Track 5: 105 BPM funk-soul groove
- Music setting in Settings changed from On/Off to a track selector: ◀ Off / Track 1–5 ▶
- Default is Track 2 at 30% volume — present from first launch, no setup needed
- Volume slider available whenever a track is active

**Power Smash Effect**
- Exceptionally powerful hits (1.5× the fast velocity threshold) trigger a special smash effect
- The pad flashes white and explodes into gold fragments that fade out
- Three distinct shatter sounds play randomly — each smash feels different
- Effect is rare enough to feel rewarding without becoming routine

**Tips Popup Scrolling**
- Tips popup is taller (320px) so most drills' tips fit without scrolling at all
- For long tips lists: joystick up/down now scrolls the content instead of closing the popup
- Joystick left/right or A button closes — scroll position resets on close
- Hint text updated to show new controls

### v0.11.0

**New Drill: REACTIVE STRIKE**
- Pads light up one at a time in random order across all 8 punch positions — no pre-announced sequence
- React to what you see, not what you memorize: tests real punch recognition vs. muscle memory
- Slip, Duck, and Pull threats appear alongside punch pads (~30% of actions) — forcing real defensive reactions between combinations
- Scored on Power, Speed, Agility (defense success + reaction speed), and Form (guard discipline) — all four standard metrics
- HUD cues switch between "HIT THE GLOWING PAD!" and "DUCK!" / "SLIP!" / "PULL BACK!" to match the active action
- Correct hits count toward fighter stats for every punch type; Speed Pressure works as normal
- Found under Punch Combos

**Drill List Sorting**
- New sort picker in the Train tab: Default (original order), New First, Most Time, Least Time
- "New First" puts recently added drills at the top — great for finding what's new after an update
- Time-based sorts use your actual session history to surface the drills you train most (or least)
- Sort persists across sessions; joystick navigation respects the active sort order

**Defense Threat Rotation Fix**
- All defense threats (slip sphere, duck bar, trailing hook, pull wall) now correctly originate from the trainer's rotated position after pivots or angle footwork
- Previously every threat spawned from the original forward direction — after a 90° pivot the ball came from the side or behind
- Threats also animate from the correct angle throughout their full swing/travel, not just at spawn

**Guide Updated**
- League table corrected to match current specs (all leagues 30s, revised speed thresholds and power thresholds, added Angle Footwork column)
- Speed options updated to include Very Fast (1.5×); Fast is 1.25×
- Power Threshold description updated: punches now always count, threshold triggers feedback + power score penalty only
- Angle Footwork setting added to settings reference

### v0.10.2

**Slip Drill Fix: Sphere Origin After Pivots/Angle Footwork**
- The slip threat sphere now correctly originates from the trainer's current position after pivots or angle footwork
- Previously the sphere always launched from the original forward direction, so after rotating 90° the ball came from the side or behind instead of the trainer
- Fixed by rotating the spawn position to match the active `pivot_angle` + `trainer_angle` before converting to world space

### v0.10.1

**Angle Footwork**
- New footwork mode: trainer rotates to a random angle (20–45°) between combos, forcing you to pivot and find a new position before punching
- Angles vary randomly in magnitude and direction each reset — no predictable left-right pattern
- Includes a small depth variation so you also need to adjust your distance after pivoting
- Enabled in all ranked leagues at 10% / 20% / 30% (Beginner / Amateur / Pro)
- Available as a standalone toggle in Custom league settings (with amount slider)

**Footwork Mode Selection**
- When multiple footwork modes are enabled (lateral, depth, angle), the trainer now randomly picks one type each reset rather than stacking them
- Keeps each round unpredictable — you won't know if you'll need to step sideways, adjust distance, or pivot to a new angle

**Body Effort Gate Removed**
- Low body engagement no longer blocks a hit from registering — punches always count
- The yellow pad flash and "USE YOUR BODY!" feedback still appear when engagement is low
- Body engagement remains 30% of your power score, so fight stats will reflect whether you're throwing with your whole body or just your arms

**Speed Tier Rebalance**
- Added "Very Fast" speed tier (1.5×) — previously Fast was 1.5× which was too aggressive
- Fast is now 1.25×, Very Fast is 1.5×
- Leagues: Beginner = Normal, Amateur = Fast, Pro = Very Fast

**League Spec Corrections**
- All ranked leagues now run 30s drills (was 30 / 45 / 60)
- Beginner: 3.0 m/s threshold, 10% body gate, lateral 20%, angle 10%
- Amateur: 5.0 m/s threshold, 20% body gate, 1200ms speed pressure, lateral 20%, depth 10%, angle 20%
- Pro: 6.0 m/s threshold, 30% body gate, 800ms speed pressure, lateral 30%, depth 20%, angle 30%

### v0.10.1

**Patch release with minor adjustments to League thresholds**
- Beginner: Normal speed, 30s, 3.0 m/s speed threshold, 10% body gate, lateral footwork ON 20%
- Amateur: Fast speed, 30s, 5.0 m/s, 20% body gate, 1200ms speed pressure, lateral 20%, depth 10%
- Pro: Very Fast speed, 30s, 6.0 m/s, 30% body gate, 800ms speed pressure, lateral 30%, depth 20%
